The Wire, Graded

Every winning waiver claim of the season, regraded every week the owner holds him. The three yardsticks are the same as the issue: the best free option at his position, the guy he cut, and his own starters, added up over every week he was started. A is 4 points, F and the bottle are 0. The GPA is the average. Tap an owner for every claim.
